content: As a software developer maintaining the GitHub repository lowRISC_ibex_pr1917, you are responsible for analyzing a submitted issue and identifying the exact location in the repository where the issue occurs.

Here is the issue description:
# [dv] Out of bounds access in dside access tracking logic
This line: https://github.com/lowRISC/ibex/blob/056cb44ff75f797898709546ea1b0fd08d862e1a/rtl/ibex_top.sv#L1092
Uses `i - 1` and it's possible to evaluate this condition when `i == 0` giving an out of bounds access. This logic needs refactoring to more explicitly split out the `i == 0` case from the others to ensure this does not occur.
> estimate 1

The issue points to an out-of-bounds array access in the d-side access tracking logic in `ibex_top.sv`, specifically from using `i - 1` inside a condition that can still be evaluated when `i == 0`. That means the primary cause is likely a loop/conditional structure that does not properly separate the `i == 0` case from the `i > 0` cases before indexing.  

To resolve it safely, the likely fix will involve:
- Refactoring the tracking logic in `rtl/ibex_top.sv` so the `i == 0` case is handled explicitly.
- Checking any helper logic or packed-array indexing used alongside this tracking to ensure no similar boundary assumptions exist.
- Potentially updating related core top-level and stage modules if the same tracking behavior is propagated or mirrored elsewhere.

Given the issue description and file structure, these are the ten files most likely to require edits:

